name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-02-23, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.33 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
